[We're official online with the DigiTechOP]{style="font-size: 1.5em; color: #8b0000"} 

![Access the recordings [here](https://www.uni.lu/fhse-en/research-projects/digitechop/).](img/digitechoflyer.png){.lightbox width=50% fig-align=center}

The official launch of the _DigiTechOP_ initiative is scheduled for October 19!

This is a collection of professionally made videos to inform and educate the general public about current scientific debates. The focus is on digital health while digital technology is discussed as a driver for sustainable societal change impacting the life experience, health, and healthcare needs of older individuals. 

Luxembourg-local and international academics as well as professionals in the private, public, and healthcare sectors contribute on an invitation basis. All contributions are recorded and post-edited by the MEDIACentre at the University of Luxembourg. 

Recordings may be used as teaching material, as resources to support training activities, or simply seen as a collection of evidence-based videos that aim to answer many, if not all questions everyone might have about old age, older people, and digital technologies.

Read the [press release](https://www.uni.lu/fhse-en/news/how-digitechop-is-rethinking-digital-inclusion-for-older-adults/) for more details on the mission and goal of this initiative.
